That satisfies "kill monsters while going down levels" loosely. But "Each level has 10 floors" explicitly. import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'

import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')

}

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D monster-hunting game about descending a 10-floor elevator level by level to floor -10, defeating and banishing the boss.

## Requirements
- Build the game now without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a browser-based Three.js game with procedural graphics and synthesized audio.
- Planned three themed 10-floor strata, a hunter with a revolver, enemy types, and a final boss.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added initial project setup and game presentation files.
- Implemented procedural audio, textures, world/elevator scenery, actors, and visual effects.

### Active
- Finish game logic and connect it to the UI; the game is not yet complete or playable.
- Run a build, fix errors, and perform browser/screenshot checks.

### Blocked
- `(none)`

## Next Move
1. Inspect existing files, especially `index.html`, to identify UI IDs and complete missing modules.
2. Implement the main game loop, combat, floor progression, enemies/boss, start/restart flows, and input handling.
3. Run the app and build; fix runtime/compiler issues.
4. Capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot; report assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI structure and expected element IDs.
- `package.json`: Vite and Three.js project setup.
- `src/style.css`: Game styling and responsive HUD.
- `src/world.js`: Elevator environment, themes, and world updates.
- `src/actors.js`: Hunter, enemy, boss, pickup, and projectile constructors.
- `src/fx.js`: Particles, hit/death effects, beams, and screen shake.
- `src/audio.js`: Synthesized game audio.
- `src/textures.js`: Procedural texture and sign helpers.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `src/main.js` has not yet been created; it is referenced by `index.html`.
- The last completed implementation was `src/fx.js`; repeated “continue” messages did not add further work.

140:     gun,
141:     muzzle,
142:     muzzleGlow,
143:     chamberGlow,
144:     recoil: 0,
145:     walkPhase: 0,
146:     animate(dt, moving, speed, t) {
147:       this.walkPhase += dt * (moving ? speed * 1.7 : 1.2)
148:       const stride = moving ? Math.min(1.2, speed / 5.5) : 0
149:       for (const leg of legs) {
150:         const s = Math.sin(this.walkPhase + (leg.side > 0 ? Math.PI : 0))
151:         leg.pivot.rotation.x = s * 0.58 * stride
152:         leg.pivot.position.y = 0.78 + Math.abs(s) * 0.03 * stride
153:       }
154:       const bob = Math.abs(Math.sin(this.walkPhase)) * 0.045 * stride
155:       body.position.y = bob + Math.sin(t * 2.2) * 0.006
156:       body.rotation.z = Math.sin(this.walkPhase) * 0.03 * stride
157:       for (const arm of arms) {
158:         arm.pivot.rotation.x = -0.12 + Math.sin(this.walkPhase * 0.5 + arm.side) * 0.04 * stride
159:       }
160:       this.recoil = Math.max(0, this.recoil - dt * 7)
161:       gun.position.z = 0.3 - this.recoil * 0.08
162:       gun.rotation.x = this.recoil * 0.22
163:       muzzleGlow.material.opacity = Math.max(0, this.recoil - 0.3) * 1.2
164:       this.chamberGlow.material.color.setHSL(0.1, 1, 0.55 + Math.sin(t * 4) * 0.08)
165:       blob.material.opacity = 0.3
166:     }
167:   }
168: }

178: function addHitbox(root, hitboxes, radius, y, part, scale = [1, 1, 1]) {
179:   const m = new THREE.Mesh(
180:     new THREE.SphereGeometry(radius, 8, 8),
181:     new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ transparent: true, opacity: 0, depthWrite: false, colorWrite: false })
182:   )
183:   m.position.y = y
184:   m.scale.set(...scale)
185:   m.userData.hitPart = part
186:   root.add(m)
187:   hitboxes.push(m)
188:   return m

- Complete a playable browser-based 3D monster-hunting game where the hunter descends an elevator through 10 floors, defeats the boss, and banishes it.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use Three.js with procedural graphics and synthesized audio.
- Planned three themed 10-floor strata, a hunter with a revolver, enemy types, and a final boss.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added initial project setup and presentation files, including procedural audio, textures, elevator scenery, actors, and visual effects.
- Inspected UI markup and existing modules.

### Active
- Implement game logic and connect it to the UI.
- Run a build, fix errors, and perform browser/screenshot checks.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the remaining `index.html` markup and module APIs.
2. Create `src/main.js` with the game loop, combat, floor progression, enemies/boss, start/restart flows, and input handling.
3. Run the app and build; resolve runtime or compilation issues.
4. Capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot; report assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI structure and expected element IDs.
- `package.json`: Vite and Three.js project setup.
- `src/style.css`: Game styling and responsive HUD.
- `src/world.js`: Elevator environment, themes, and world updates.
- `src/actors.js`: Hunter, enemy, boss, pickup, and projectile constructors.
- `src/fx.js`: Particles, hit/death effects, beams, and screen shake.
- `src/audio.js`: Synthesized game audio.
- `src/textures.js`: Procedural texture and sign helpers.

## Important Context
- `src/main.js` is missing but referenced by `index.html`.
- Changes are uncommitted.

## Objective
- Complete a playable browser-based 3D monster-hunting game where the hunter descends an elevator through 10 floors, defeats the boss, and banishes it.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use Three.js with procedural graphics and synthesized audio.
- Planned three themed 10-floor strata, a hunter with a revolver, enemy types, and a final boss.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added initial project setup and presentation files, including procedural audio, textures, elevator scenery, actors, and visual effects.
- Inspected UI markup and existing module APIs.

### Active
- Implement game logic and connect it to the UI.
- Run a build, fix errors, and perform browser/screenshot checks.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the remaining `index.html` markup and module APIs.
2. Create `src/main.js` with the game loop, combat, floor progression, enemies/boss, start/restart flows, and input handling.
3. Run the app and build; resolve runtime or compilation issues.
4. Capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot; report assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI structure and expected element IDs.
- `package.json`: Vite and Three.js project setup.
- `src/style.css`: Game styling and responsive HUD.
- `src/world.js`: Elevator environment, themes, and world updates.
- `src/actors.js`: Hunter, enemy, boss, pickup, and projectile constructors.
- `src/fx.js`: Particles, hit/death effects, beams, and screen shake.
- `src/audio.js`: Synthesized game audio.
- `src/textures.js`: Procedural texture and sign helpers.

## Important Context
- `src/main.js` is missing but referenced by `index.html`.
- Changes are uncommitted.

149:       for (const leg of legs) {

151:         leg.pivot.rotation.x = s * 0.58 * stride

160:       this.recoil = Math.max(0, this.recoil - dt * 7)
161:       gun.position.z = 0.3 - this.recoil * 0.08
162:       gun.rotation.x = this.recoil * 0.22
163:       muzzleGlow.material.opacity = Math.max(0, this.recoil - 0.3) * 1.2
164:       this.chamberGlow.material.color.setHSL(0.1, 1, 0.55 + Math.sin(t * 4) * 0.08)
165:       blob.material.opacity = 0.3
166:     }
167:   }

178: function addHitbox(root, hitboxes, radius, y, part, scale = [1, 1, 1]) {
179:   const m = new THREE.Mesh(

436:         s.scale.setScalar(0.38 + Math.sin(t * 3 + i) * 0.05)
437:       })
438:     }
439:   }
440: }

285: export function makeGlowTexture(inner = 'rgba(255,255,255,1)', outer = 'rgba(255,255,255,0)') {
286:   const size = 128
287:   const c = canvas(size, size)
288:   const ctx = c.getContext('2d')
289:   const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(size / 2, size / 2, 0, size / 2, size / 2, size / 2)
290:   g.addColorStop(0, inner)
291:   g.addColorStop(0.32, inner.replace(/[\d.]+\)$/, '0.55)'))
292:   g.addColorStop(1, outer)
293:   ctx.fillStyle = g
294:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size)
295:   const t = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c)
296:   t.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace
297:   return t
298: }

300: export function makeSigilTexture(accent = '#ff3d50') {
301:   const size = 512
302:   const c = canvas(size, size)
303:   const ctx = c.getContext('2d')
304:   const cx = size / 2, cy = size / 2
305:   ctx.translate(cx, cy)
306:   ctx.strokeStyle = accent
307:   ctx.globalAlpha = 1
308:   ctx.lineWidth = 4
309:   for (const r of [230, 188, 154]) {
310:     ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke()
311:   }
312:   ctx.lineWidth = 3
313:   for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
314:     const a = (i / 12) * Math.PI * 2
315:     ctx.beginPath()
316:     ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(a) * 154, Math.sin(a) * 154)
317:     ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * 188, Math.sin(a) * 188)
318:     ctx.stroke()
319:   }
320:   ctx.beginPath()
321:   for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
322:     const a = -Math.PI / 2 + (i * 6 * Math.PI) / 7
323:     const x = Math.cos(a) * 140, y = Math.sin(a) * 140
324:     if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y)
325:   }
326:   ctx.closePath()
327:   ctx.stroke()
328:   ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5
329:   ctx.lineWidth = 2
330:   for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
331:     const a = (i / 28) * Math.PI * 2
332:     ctx.beginPath()
333:     ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(a) * 195, Math.sin(a) * 195)
334:     ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * 226, Math.sin(a) * 226)
335:     ctx.stroke()
336:   }
337:   const t = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c)
338:   t.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace
339:   return t
340: }

324:       if (beam.life <= 0) {
325:         beam.active = false
326:         beam.mesh.visible = false
327:       }
328:     }

330:     for (const ring of this.rings) {
331:       if (!ring.active) continue
332:       ring.life -= dt
333:       const t = 1 - Math.max(0, ring.life / ring.maxLife)
334:       const r = ring.start + (ring.end - ring.start) * (1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 2))
335:       ring.mesh.scale.setScalar(r)
336:       ring.material.opacity = ring.opacity * (1 - t)

347:     this.shake = Math.max(0, this.shake - dt * this.shakeDecay)
348:   }

## Objective
- Complete a playable browser-based 3D monster-hunting game: descend through three themed strata of 10 floors each, defeat the final boss, and banish it.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use Three.js with procedural graphics and synthesized audio.
- Build on the existing procedural world, actors, effects, and audio modules.

## Work State
### Completed
- Project presentation and supporting modules are present.
- Inspected the UI markup and module APIs needed to connect gameplay.

### Active
- Implement `src/main.js` with the game loop, combat, floor progression, enemies/boss, start/restart flows, and input handling.
- Build and run the game; fix runtime or compilation issues and perform the requested visual check.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Create `src/main.js`, connecting the existing modules to the UI and implementing gameplay.
2. Run the Vite build and test the game in a browser; address any errors.
3. Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot; report assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: UI structure, element IDs, and module entry point.
- `package.json`: Vite and Three.js scripts/dependencies.
- `src/world.js`: Themed elevator world and updates.
- `src/actors.js`: Hunter, enemy, boss, pickup, and projectile constructors.
- `src/fx.js`: Particles, hit/death effects, beams, and screen shake.
- `src/audio.js`: Synthesized game audio.
- `src/style.css`: Game styling and responsive HUD.
- `src/textures.js`: Procedural textures and signs.

## Important Context
- `src/main.js` is missing but referenced by `index.html`.
- Changes are uncommitted.

## Objective
- Complete a playable browser-based 3D monster-hunting game: descend through three themed strata of 10 floors each, defeat the final boss, and banish it.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use Three.js with procedural graphics and synthesized audio.
- Build on the existing procedural world, actors, effects, and audio modules.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented `src/main.js` with the game loop, combat, floor progression, enemies and boss, start/restart flows, HUD, keyboard/mouse input, and touch controls.
### Active
- Build and run the game; fix runtime or compilation issues and perform the requested visual check.
### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run the Vite build and test the game in a browser; address any errors.
2. Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.
3. Report assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: gameplay implementation; recently created and not yet verified.
- `index.html`: UI structure, element IDs, and module entry point.
- `package.json`: Vite and Three.js scripts/dependencies.
- `src/world.js`: themed elevator world and updates.
- `src/actors.js`: hunter, enemy, boss, pickup, and projectile constructors.
- `src/fx.js`: particles, hit/death effects, beams, and screen shake.
- `src/audio.js`: synthesized game audio.
- `src/style.css`: game styling and responsive HUD.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `src/main.js` relies on the existing module APIs and UI element IDs; integration and browser runtime remain unverified.

## Objective
- Complete a playable browser-based 3D monster-hunting game: descend through three themed strata of 10 floors each, defeat the final boss, and banish it.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use Three.js with procedural graphics and synthesized audio.
- Build on the existing procedural world, actors, effects, and audio modules.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented `src/main.js` with the game loop, combat, floor progression, enemies and boss, start/restart flows, HUD, keyboard/mouse input, and touch controls.
- Installed dependencies with `npm install`; `npm run build` succeeds.

### Active
- Test the game in a browser, fix runtime or gameplay issues, and perform the requested visual check.

### Blocked
- Browser check and screenshot remain pending.

## Next Move
1. Run the Vite app and test it in a browser; address runtime or gameplay errors.
2. Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.
3. Report assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: gameplay implementation; build passes, browser runtime not yet verified.
- `index.html`: UI structure and element IDs used by the game.
- `package.json`: Vite and Three.js scripts/dependencies.
- `src/world.js`: themed elevator world and updates.
- `src/actors.js`: hunter, enemy, boss, pickup, and projectile constructors.
- `src/fx.js`: particles, hit/death effects, beams, and screen shake.
- `src/audio.js`: synthesized game audio.
- `src/style.css`: game styling and responsive HUD.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `npm run build` completed successfully; Vite reported a chunk-size warning for the ~610 kB minified JS bundle.
- `npm install` completed with 0 vulnerabilities.
